items.evidence: Reservoir in slot 1 and plate in slot 2 loaded with the correct labels; p20 left with the 20ul rack in slot 10 and p300 right with the 300ul rack in slot 11.
Log shows 100 uL aspirated from reservoir A1 and dispensed into plate A1, then 100 uL into B1, all with the p300; no other wells touched.
Each aspirate/dispense is preceded by a pick up tip, and the log ends with a drop tip so no tip is held at the end.
100 uL is within the p300 range, apiLevel 2.15 is valid, and the simulation passed with no errors.
The single transfer step is implemented exactly; the comments and metadata are accurate and make no claims of actions that are not performed.

judge.summary: The protocol loads the specified deck and performs the 100 µL transfers from reservoir A1 to plate A1 and B1 with the p300, as the log confirms. Tips are handled correctly, and all values are within limits.
